parties.respondent: State Represented by The Inspector of Police & Anr.

summary: Quashing of chargesheet sought; no allegations of instigation or misrepresentation by appellants; complainant 29-year-old postgraduate; physical relations with son based on personal relationship; parents' role not criminal; no ingredients of cheating under IPC s.415 or abetment under s.109; reliance on Vishnu Kumar Shukla v. State of Uttar Pradesh; no grave suspicion of guilt; protection from vexatious prosecution; charges against son unaffected.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; chargesheet against appellants quashed; proceedings against appellants' son unaffected.
